game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Pumice Pass open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Pumice Pass open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fire warden ahead. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ember furnace by solving code steps involving gates_open that move the fire warden forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ember furnace first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
